description:
Are you a dedicated Physical Therapist Assistant looking for a rewarding full-time opportunity in a vibrant community? Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in St. Petersburg, FL, where you'll play a crucial role in helping patients regain independence and improve their quality of life. This facility, with a capacity of 55-59 beds and a current census of 43, offers a supportive environment focused on patient-centered care.

Located conveniently on a main street with abundant shopping nearby and a nice residential neighborhood behind the building, this role offers an excellent work-life balance. Imagine being just 15 minutes from the beautiful beaches, perfect for unwinding after work. The facility itself boasts two courtyards, providing pleasant outdoor spaces for both patients and staff. We are seeking a passionate PTA to contribute to our team and make a significant impact on our residents' well-being.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in the state of Florida.
Experience working in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Strong clinical skills and a commitment to patient care.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38.00 - $48.00, based on experience.

description:

description:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Regional Marketing Director to lead business development and marketing initiatives across multiple premier health and rehabilitation centers in Oklahoma. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies, fostering key relationships, and driving census growth for our facilities. roleTitle: Travel Labor and Delivery Registered Nurse (RN)
description:
Join a premier hospital in Tyler, TX, as a Travel Labor and Delivery Registered Nurse. This contract position offers a unique opportunity to provide specialized care to expectant mothers and newborns, contributing to positive birthing experiences in a supportive environment. We are seeking a dedicated professional ready to make an immediate impact.

This role is perfect for an experienced L&D RN looking for a travel assignment with a clear start date. You will be an integral part of a compassionate team, ensuring the highest standards of patient care throughout the labor, delivery, and postpartum phases. Embrace the chance to expand your skills and experience in a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Texas or a compact state
Minimum of 1-2 years of recent Labor and Delivery experience
Current BLS, ACLS, and NRP certifications
Ability to adapt quickly to new hospital environments and protocols
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $50.71. Contract begins July 13, 2026.
